question: Visva Bharati a famous educational institute was founded in 1921 by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rabindranath Tagore**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rabindranath Tagore** founded Visva Bharati in 1921.
 
• Visva Bharati is a renowned educational institute located in Santiniketan, West Bengal.
 
• Tagore envisioned it as a place where the world would meet in a single nest, promoting unity and understanding among cultures.
 
• The institution focuses on the principles of holistic education, integrating art, culture, and human values.
 
• It has since grown to become a central university and an institution of national importance in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rabindranath Tagore** was a polymath who reshaped Bengali literature and music, as well as Indian art with contextual modernism in the late 19th and early 20th centuries.
 
• He became the** first non-European to win the Nobel Prize in Literature **in 1913 for his collection of poems, "Gitanjali".
 
• **Tagore's vision for Visva Bharati** was to create a learning environment that transcended the conventional boundaries of education, blending the best of Eastern and Western philosophies.
 
• Today, Visva Bharati continues to uphold Tagore's legacy, fostering a spirit of open-mindedness and creativity among its students.
